channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: a16z leads Eka Robotics' Series A: a Vision-Force-Action model that lets robot hands feel contact
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Andreessen Horowitz is leading Eka Robotics' Series A, announced October 20. The startup's Vision-Force-Action model fuses vision and force feedback from robotic hands — reporting 1,500 picks per hour, 2.5x faster than humans.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer: its V4.1-Flash inference engine, on Nvidia and Huawei chips
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, the inference framework that powers its production services, on October 20 — Apache 2.0 code running DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on both Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs.

item.title: Otter.ai lands $320M from General Catalyst — and gives up no equity for it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Otter.ai announced $320 million in growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund on October 20 — repayable capital that leaves the cap table untouched — to fund enterprise growth and international expansion.

item.title: ASI raises $325M at a $3B valuation for the AI that forecasts planes, grids, and battlefields — not chatbots
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Boston-based ASI announced a $325 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation on October 20, led by Spark Capital, to scale simulation and monitoring software that helps operators forecast disruptions across air traffic, power grids, and military systems.

item.title: Turn your agent's production failures into regression tests: a hands-on guide to Tracely
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Tracely (jwuthri-cloud, MIT, ~1,150 stars) is trace-native CI/CD for AI agents: it grades every production trace as it lands, freezes the failing runs into hermetic regression cases, and blocks the pull request that would ship the failure again — replayed for $0, with no API keys.

item.title: Blackwall raises $100M at $2.2B valuation to hold back the AI bot flood
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Estonia's Blackwall announced a $100 million Series C at a $2.2 billion valuation on October 20, as AI agents flood the web with automated traffic that hosting providers can't filter alone.

item.title: BCG's AI Maturity Matrix 2026: Japan and South Korea join the AI Pioneers as execution replaces ambition
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Boston Consulting Group's AI Maturity Matrix 2026, released October 20, finds Japan and South Korea joining the nine AI Pioneer economies and names financial services among the sectors most exposed to AI disruption.

item.title: ThreatModeler launches NexusAI: agentic AI that keeps threat models alive as code ships
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: ThreatModeler today launched NexusAI, an agentic AI threat-modeling partner inside the ThreatModeler Nexus platform — automating model creation, security analysis, and upkeep as software ships, all built on the company's Secure Design Graph.

item.title: AI search said ‘not listed,’ the sanctions list said otherwise: 17 wrong answers in 96 company checks
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SanctionsKit tested one search engine's AI summaries against an official U.S. sanctions list across 96 companies: 17 summaries got the sanctions status wrong — including three that cleared companies the official records said were listed.

item.title: Lincoln Electric launches XpertLINC: physical AI that lets welding robots adapt like a human — no programming needed
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Lincoln Electric (Nasdaq: LECO) announced XpertLINC, a physical-AI platform that lets welding robots scan joint geometry and adjust their path on the fly — no programming or CAD files required. It debuts on Cooper welding cobots and demos live at FABTECH, October 21–23.

item.title: 94% of UK firms moved AI beyond pilots — but only 22% can see it: Datadog’s 2026 operational AI report
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Datadog’s State of Operational AI in Europe 2026 finds UK firms racing past the pilot stage — 94% in production — while only 22% of IT leaders have complete visibility into their AI systems. Meanwhile 38% say AI costs blew past expectations.

item.title: Direct a short film with an AI agent — no video model required: a hands-on guide to lemo-opuscar
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: lemo-opuscar (lemomo-ai, MIT, 4,100+ stars) is a Claude Code skill that directs short films made entirely in code — canvas and WebGL frames, synthesized scores, TTS narration. Full hands-on: install, pick from 51 styles, commission your film, and design your own style.

item.title: Neolix raises $400M: China's robovan giant goes global with Alibaba and a national AI fund
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Announced October 20: Neolix closed a nearly $400 million Series E — co-led by Boyu Capital and a national-level fund, with Alibaba joining — to take its driverless delivery vans global; total funding tops $1.4 billion.

item.title: AlphaGo co-creator Thore Graepel launches Metis Reasoning, a compute-efficient AI startup that wants machines to show their work
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Launched October 20: AlphaGo co-creator Thore Graepel's new London startup Metis Reasoning argues AI progress needs auditable reasoning, not ever-larger language models — and says its prototype already tackles PhD-level science.

item.title: OVHcloud enters the model race: its first AI model lands early 2027, trained on Europe's Jupiter supercomputer
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Announced October 20: OVHcloud CEO Octave Klaba says the French cloud giant will launch its first AI model in early 2027 — a mixture-of-experts system trained on Jupiter, Europe's fastest supercomputer — after posting 250MW of connected capacity, half of it free for new clients.

item.title: Databuddy joins Y Combinator with $560K: an AI analyst that investigates why your product metrics moved
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Twenty-year-old founder Issa Nassar's Databuddy — an AI-driven analytics platform that investigates conversion drops and product issues on a team's behalf — announced a $500,000 Y Combinator seed round, bringing its total raised to more than $560,000.

item.title: NEURA Robotics teams with NXAI to give cognitive robots a lasting memory — xLSTM meets the Physical AI stack
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Announced October 20 in Metzingen, the two-part partnership weaves NXAI's xLSTM memory architecture into NEURA's Physical AI stack — and adds a second model to the Neuraverse platform.

item.title: Stop your RAG from guessing: a hands-on tour of 42 battle-tested retrieval techniques
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NirDiamant/RAG_Techniques has nearly 30,000 stars and 42 runnable notebooks covering every upgrade path from naive chunk-and-retrieve to Self-RAG and Corrective RAG. This guide runs the baseline, tunes the chunks, fixes the queries, adds guardrails, and shows how to measure the difference.

item.title: DolphinOne 2.0 launches worldwide on the App Store — and Virtual Mind disclosed no users, revenue, or pricing
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Virtual Mind Holding launched DolphinOne 2.0 — a multi-model AI creation and intelligent-agent platform — globally on the Apple App Store on October 20, 2026. Its voluntary announcement disclosed no user, revenue, or pricing figures.

item.title: Would a design team actually ship it? AtelierBench launches to grade AI against real client briefs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SILVERSIDE and Hyde launched AtelierBench on October 20: a first-of-its-kind benchmark that judges AI models on the thing current benchmarks skip — whether the work survives a real client brief, expert judgment, and a design team’s standards.

item.title: Binance AI Pro goes public: an AI agent that turns trading ideas into tested strategies — with a free tier
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Binance rolled out AI Pro to all users globally on October 19, 2026: a conversational AI agent that turns plain-English trading ideas into visual, testable, deployable strategies — with a free tier built on DeepSeek.

item.title: Cloudflare launches Clairic, the first 'System One' extraction model: typed values in one pass, no output tokens
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cloudflare announced Clairic on October 19, 2026, the first System One extraction model: a Workers AI preview that extracts, computes, estimates, and forecasts typed values from text and images in a single forward pass, billed only for input tokens at $0.10 per million.

item.title: Anthropic in talks for second $45B Nscale deal: 460MW of Vera Rubin chips in West Virginia
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic is negotiating a second roughly $45B cloud deal with Nscale — 460MW of Nvidia Vera Rubin compute for a second facility at the Monarch campus in West Virginia — as investors press to cut the lab's IPO valuation.

item.title: Meta completes Prometheus phase one: the gigawatt supercluster that trained Muse Wonder
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta says the first phase of Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster in New Albany, Ohio, is complete — and it has already trained the Muse family, including Muse Wonder. Inside the two NVIDIA rack platforms, the 100-km network, and the 64-of-72 sparing trick behind 85%+ goodput.

item.title: Give your AI agent a PhD supervisor: a hands-on guide to Supervisor-Skills
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: HKUST's 10,100-star Supervisor-Skills distills a decade of PhD-advisor publishing experience into installable AI skills for research: idea evaluation, introduction drafting, literature surveys, and paper polishing. This guide installs the skills in your coding agent and walks the full idea-to-submission loop hands-on.
